Razak, Ahmad and Nurhaliza, Siti (2023) Determinants of E-Wallet Adoption among Malaysian Small and Medium Enterprises: A UTAUT2 Perspective . Malaysian Journal of Information Technology and Computer Science, 15 (2). pp. 112-128.
DOI: 10.11113/mjitcs.v15n2.98124
This study examines the behavioral intentions of Malaysian SMEs toward continuous adoption of digital e-wallets. Using an extended Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT2) model incorporating perceived transaction security and government subsidies under the Malaysia Digital Economy Blueprint, structural equation modeling was conducted on survey data collected from 240 retail entrepreneurs in Johor and Selangor.

DOI: 10.11113/jt.v84.92305
Digital payment solutions have surged across urban Malaysian commercial centers. However, fraud vectors, unauthorized micro-transactions, and QR code tampering remain key obstacles for small micro-merchants. This paper surveys 310 micro-merchants and details threat mitigation techniques aligned with Bank Negara Malaysia security guidelines.
